data.title: Stamn One
data.about:
Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Garden City, Satmn One is an exceptional 6-story project by Stamn Real Estate Development. Featuring thoughtfully designed studio to 2-bedroom apartments, this low-rise building provides cozy, tranquil homes equipped with smart home features. Each unit boasts a pantry and a private balcony with an outdoor deck, creating a versatile green space for leisure and relaxation. The design incorporates premium materials such as rock slabs, wood, stone, and stainless steel, ensuring a harmonious balance between aesthetics and functionality.

Residents can enjoy exclusive amenities, including an infinity pool and a pool deck located on the upper floor, perfect for unwinding after a busy day. The design philosophy of Stamn One at Jumeirah Garden City, Dubai emphasizes comfort and elegance, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a peaceful retreat within the bustling city.

characteristics_module.title: Stamn One at Jumeirah Garden City, Dubai: A Blend of Modern Technology & Wellness-Focused Amenities
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Smart Home Apartments: Experience the convenience of advanced smart home technology, offering seamless control over your living environment.
  • Prime Location in Jumeirah Garden City: Nestled in the prestigious Jumeirah Garden City, Satmn One provides easy access to Dubai's major attractions while offering a tranquil and vibrant community atmosphere.
  • Yoga Lounge for Relaxation: A dedicated yoga lounge designed to promote wellness, relaxation, and a healthy lifestyle, right at your doorstep.
  • Roof Landscape: Enjoy breathtaking views and serene green spaces on the rooftop, perfect for unwinding or socializing in a tranquil setting.
  • Ball Game Facilities: Dedicated areas for recreational sports and games, providing a dynamic space for both fitness and fun.
  • Aquatic Sports: Dive into exciting aquatic activities and make the most of the state-of-the-art water facilities available within the development.
  • Completion by 2026: A guaranteed timeline ensures your new home will be ready in 2026, offering a perfect blend of innovation, comfort, and community.

location_tile.title: Setting a New Standard for Contemporary Living in Dubai
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The freehold development features low-rise projects and is strategically positioned parallel to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), one of the UAE’s major highways. Developed by Meraas Holding, the Jumeirah Garden City aims to transform Al Satwa into a vibrant vertical community. This mixed-use development provides a well-rounded and dynamic lifestyle with convenient access to retail outlets, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and entertainment options.

  • 5 Minutes - Sheikh Zayed Road (E11)
  • 10 Minutes - Downtown Dubai
  • 10 Minutes - Dubai World Trade Centre
  • 15 Minutes - Dubai Mall
  • 20 Minutes - Dubai Marina
